svg.title: Hux V1-PROOF Connector loading
svg.desc: Logical position schedules, not connector face views. XH = JST XH 2.50 mm. Verify position 1 on the actual mating parts. PH-C spans both Pico rows: physical interface unresolved. Source-checked planning drawing; proposed harnesses and unresolved interfaces require physical verification.
svg.text: Logical position schedules, not connector face views. XH = JST XH 2.50 mm. Verify position 1 on the actual mating parts. PH-C spans both Pico rows: physical interface unresolved.
Rev C | Source: 17 OCT 2026 | Print layout: 17 OCT 2026
17 x 11 in / landscape / 0.5 in margins / print at 100%. Sources and open checks: docs/wiring-atlas.md.

Pack leads, the inline fuse and the laptop USB cable are not listed; they are not harness connectors. The three empty Pico positions in PH-D keep GP19–GP21 free for a later revision.
